description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate the Oracle data tier and database credentials to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including schema, SQL syntax, and photo BLOB storage.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle Database with Oracle-specific JDBC driver, OracleDialect, and BLOB data types. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service on Azure, eliminating the need for self-managed Oracle infrastructure.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle data source with Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Migrate the schema and adapt Oracle-specific SQL to PostgreSQL-compatible equivalents, including conversion of photo BLOB storage to PostgreSQL bytea. Replace plaintext database credentials with managed identity authentication.
